summary: A project management dashboard showing team statistics, recent project progress, status indicators, and navigation for workspace management.

stack.name: React + Vite
stack.why: Fast development server and robust component architecture.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Utility-first CSS framework for rapid styling matching the design tokens.

stack.name: Lucide Icons
stack.why: Provides clean, scalable UI icons for navigation and actions.

components.name: Sidebar
components.purpose: Renders the dark navigation panel with app logo, menu links, and user settings.

components.name: StatCard
components.purpose: Displays key metrics and trend indicators in a card layout.

components.name: ProjectTable
components.purpose: Lists recent projects with progress bars, owners, status badges, and due dates.

steps.title: Project Setup
steps.detail: Initialize React + Vite project with Tailwind CSS. Configure custom fonts and colors matching the dark sidebar and light main content area.

steps.title: Layout Shell
steps.detail: Create the main app shell with a fixed dark sidebar on the left and a scrollable white content area on the right.

steps.title: Sidebar Navigation
steps.detail: Implement navigation links with active state styling for Dashboard, Projects, My tasks, Reports, Team, Settings, and Log out.

steps.title: Dashboard Header
steps.detail: Build the top search bar, notification bell icon, and user avatar with initials 'AK'.

steps.title: Metrics Grid
steps.detail: Create the four-column grid of statistics cards displaying active projects, tasks due, completed items, and team members.

steps.title: Recent Projects Table
steps.detail: Build the table component showing project name, owner, visual progress bar, status badges (On track, At risk, Blocked), and due date.

steps.title: Interactivity and State
steps.detail: Add click handlers for navigation links, the '+ New project' button modal trigger, and search input filtering.

behaviour: Sidebar links: navigate between different views or highlight the active route.
Search input: filters projects and tasks in real-time as the user types.
+ New project button: opens a modal dialog to create a new project.
View all link: navigates to the full projects listing page.
data: stats: activeProjects, tasksDue, completedTasks, teamMembers with sub-metrics
projects: name, owner, progress percentage, status badge type, due date
